summary: Provision 25 seats for Metrics Platform and complete vendor onboarding for LambdaDB Analytics
description: Issue summary: The Data Platform team requests 25 additional SaaS seats for the Metrics Platform (dashboarding) and asks Procurement to onboard a new vendor, LambdaDB Analytics, for advanced time-series analytics. Impact: 25 engineers and analysts are blocked from joining the org workspace; a planned Q2 performance baseline for customer usage depends on LambdaDB’s connectors. Environment: prod. Request: (1) Procure 25 seats and map billing center to Cloud Ops; (2) Complete vendor onboarding (security questionnaire, SSO/SAML integration, PO issuance); (3) Schedule vendor kickoff and sandbox access for the Data Platform team by 2026-03-22. Background: Metrics Platform usage has grown with two new product initiatives; existing seat pool exhausted. LambdaDB was selected after a short evaluation for its Delta ingestion connectors and per-series query performance. Requirements: vendor SOC2 attestation, customer-specific IP allowlist, SSO via Okta, and a one-time onboarding workshop. Timeline: Needs to be live for testing by 2026-03-22 to meet Q2 measurement windows. Approvers: Procurement lead and Finance manager must sign PO.
acceptance_criteria: 25 seats provisioned and confirmed in Metrics Platform admin console
Vendor SSO (Okta) integrated and tested with two pilot users
Signed PO uploaded to Procurement folder and billed to Cloud Ops
Security questionnaire marked ‘Reviewed’ and SOC2 report attached
